description: Every-block LP valuations with UTC minute OHLC and a causal opening LP oracle. Data preparation only; AMM replay is separate.

candles.dtype: little-endian float64 in prices.npy; integer WAD prices in prices.jsonl.gz

oracle.oracle_updates: One modeled price_w per nonempty UTC minute using the latest completed block at or before the minute start
oracle.oracle_initialization: First historical virtual price at its actual source timestamp

quote_convention: Preserve target deployment: USD/LP Oracle consumed numerically by crvUSD AMM; Spot is crvUSD/LP
loading: Load prices.npy with numpy.load: columns 0:6 are timestamp/OHLC/zero volume, column 6 is the separately prepared LP oracle. Timestamps are Unix seconds.
Do not calculate a second candle EMA or convert the oracle denomination.

Prepare AMM oracle memory over the full supplied oracle history before run/window cuts using the separate causal-oracle initialization patch. This archive intentionally contains no AMM state or simulation results.
historical_point_files: The existing history.jsonl.gz and prices.jsonl.gz in this repository are the earlier sparse point dataset. history.jsonl.gz is retained as the seed for filling every missing block; the release above is the current minute dataset.
collection_command: uv run --frozen --python 3.11.15 python -m simulator.import_data.reusd_sfrxusd_lp_blocks --history data/REUSD_SFRXUSD_LP/history.jsonl.gz --source-sha256 2c69962adf44796f244eccfd890d5531e062fcc83079907b0878927b6b29f382 --cache tmp-lp-block-cache --output tmp-lp-block-history.jsonl.gz
collection_notes: Optional recollection uses ETH_RPC_URL, verifies the chain anchor and sampled reused rows, and fetches missing blocks. Offline preparation needs no RPC. Recollected headers carry the current collector hash; the released raw file preserves original collection provenance.

validation.scope: Full input comparison against the completed causal-method run. Prepared record bodies and all six arrays are unchanged; metadata identifies the standalone preparer. No AMM simulation rerun.
